description: This file defines the 'Fund' entity class for the Fineract project, representing a financial fund with properties like name and external ID, including methods for instantiation from JSON commands and updating its state.

classes.name: Fund
classes.description: Entity class representing a financial fund with properties for name and external ID, supporting creation from JSON commands and updates.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Fund instance from a JSON command object by extracting 'name' and 'externalId' parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the Fund's name and external ID based on changes signaled in a JSON command, returning a map of changed fields.
